## Loading in Libraries

```{r}
library(tuneR)
library(seewave)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(ppls)
```

## Loading in Data

```{r}

#reading in data
annotatedAW = read.csv(here::here("annotatedMelAWFull2000-1.csv"))

annotatedAW = annotatedAW %>% mutate(Humpback = as.factor(Humpback))

annotatedAW


```

## Table of Reponse Variable

```{r}
table(annotatedAW$Humpback)

```

## Per-Group Summary Statistics


```{r}
#calculating group means

annotatedAW %>% filter(Humpback == 1) %>% summarise(mean(V1), mean(V2), sd(V1))

annotatedAW %>% filter(Humpback == 0) %>% summarise(mean(V1), mean(V2), sd(V1))




```


## Histogram of Mel Coefficients

```{r}
#histogram of Mel Coefficients by Humpback instance



annotatedAW  %>% ggplot(aes(x = V1)) + geom_histogram() + facet_grid(rows = vars(Humpback))



annotatedAW  %>% ggplot(aes(x = V2)) + geom_histogram() + facet_grid(rows = vars(Humpback))

annotatedAW  %>% ggplot(aes(x = V3)) + geom_histogram() + facet_grid(rows = vars(Humpback))


#ggplot(data = your_dataset, aes(x = x_variable, y = y_variable))
```

## MFCCs over time

### V1


```{r}
annotatedAW %>% filter(0 <= Time_Start & Time_Start <= 100) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Time_Start, y = V1, col = Humpback)) + geom_point() + 
  labs(title = "V1 Over Time, Colored by Humpback Presence",
       x = "Time (seconds)")
```

### V6


```{r}
annotatedAW %>% filter(0 <= Time_Start & Time_Start <= 100) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Time_Start, y = V6, col = Humpback)) + geom_point() + 
  labs(title = "V6 Over Time, Colored by Humpback Presence",
       x = "Time (seconds)")
```


### V12

```{r}

annotatedAW %>% filter(0 <= Time_Start & Time_Start <= 100) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Time_Start, y = V12, col = Humpback)) + geom_point() + 
  labs(title = "V12 Over Time, Colored by Humpback Presence",
       x = "Time (seconds)")

```



## Plotting Differences

```{r}
#differences between coefficients

annotatedAW %>% mutate(V12diff = c(0, diff(V12)))

annotatedAW %>% mutate(V12diff = c(0, diff(V12))) %>% 
  filter(0 < Time_Start & Time_Start <= 100) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Time_Start, y = V12diff, col = Humpback)) + geom_point() + 
  labs(title = "Diff V12 Over Time, Colored by Humpback Presence",
       x = "Time (seconds)")

```


## Plotting Normalized Vectors

```{r}
annotatedAW = annotatedAW %>% mutate(V1normalize = normalize.vector(V1),
                       V12normalize = normalize.vector(V12))


annotatedAW %>% filter(0 <= Time_Start & Time_Start <= 100) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Time_Start, y = V1normalize, col = Humpback)) + geom_point() + 
  labs(title = "V1 Normalized Over Time, Colored by Humpback Presence",
       x = "Time (seconds)")

annotatedAW %>% filter(0 <= Time_Start & Time_Start <= 100) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Time_Start, y = V12normalize, col = Humpback)) + geom_point() + 
  labs(title = "V12 Normalized Over Time, Colored by Humpback Presence",
       x = "Time (seconds)")



```
